title: Neuroimaging & Neuroscience
blurb: Brain MRI, fMRI, PET and EEG collections for ageing, dementia, development and psychiatric research.

items.name: ADNI
items.description: Longitudinal MRI, PET, CSF/blood biomarkers, genetics and cognitive data from >2,000 participants (normal, MCI, Alzheimer's) since 2004.
items.provider: ADNI / LONI, University of Southern California
items.access_note: Free; online application via LONI IDA and Data Use Agreement.

items.name: OASIS
items.full_name: Open Access Series of Imaging Studies
items.description: Brain MRI (and PET in OASIS-3/4) with clinical and cognitive data across normal ageing and Alzheimer's disease, from Washington University's Knight ADRC.
items.access_note: Free; agree to the Data Use Agreement and register on NITRC-IR/XNAT Central.

paper.label: Marcus DS et al. J Cogn Neurosci 2007;19:1498

items.name: OpenNeuro
items.description: Open platform hosting 1,000+ BIDS-formatted neuroimaging datasets (MRI, MEG, EEG, iEEG, PET) contributed by researchers worldwide.

items.name: Human Connectome Project
items.description: High-quality multimodal MRI (structural, resting/task fMRI, diffusion) and behavioural data from ~1,200 healthy young adults, plus Lifespan and disease extensions.
items.access_note: Free ConnectomeDB account + Open Access Data Use Terms; restricted data by application.

paper.label: Van Essen DC et al. NeuroImage 2013;80:62

items.name: ABIDE
items.description: Resting-state fMRI and structural MRI from >2,000 individuals with autism and typical controls aggregated from 24+ international sites.

paper.label: Di Martino A et al. Mol Psychiatry 2014;19:659

items.name: ABCD Study
items.description: Largest long-term study of brain development in the US: ~11,800 children followed from age 9–10 with MRI, cognition, mental health, substance use and genetics.
items.access_note: Free; institutional Data Use Certification via the NIH Brain Development Cohorts data hub.

paper.label: Casey BJ et al. Dev Cogn Neurosci 2018;32:43

items.name: NIMH Data Archive (NDA)
items.description: Federated archive of human-subjects mental-health research data (clinical, imaging, genomics) from hundreds of NIH-funded studies, including ABCD and HCP lifespan.
items.provider: US National Institute of Mental Health
items.access_note: Free; Data Use Certification signed by your institution.

items.name: IXI Dataset
items.description: ~600 MR images (T1, T2, PD, MRA, DTI) from healthy subjects scanned at three London hospitals.

items.name: BraTS
items.description: Multi-institutional multiparametric MRI (T1, T1-Gd, T2, FLAIR) of gliomas and other brain tumours with expert segmentations of tumour sub-regions.
items.access_note: Free Synapse registration for the yearly challenge data.

paper.label: Menze BH et al. IEEE Trans Med Imaging 2015;34:1993

items.name: TUH EEG Corpus
items.description: The world's largest open clinical EEG corpus (>30,000 recordings) from Temple University Hospital with physician reports; subsets annotated for seizures, artefacts and abnormality.
items.provider: Neural Engineering Data Consortium, Temple University
items.access_note: Free; submit a signed data-sharing form to receive credentials.

paper.label: Obeid I, Picone J. Front Neurosci 2016;10:196

items.name: CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database
items.description: Long-term scalp EEG of 22 paediatric subjects with intractable seizures at Boston Children's Hospital, with annotated seizure onsets.
items.provider: Boston Children's Hospital / MIT via PhysioNet

items.name: Siena Scalp EEG Database
items.description: EEG recordings of 14 adult epilepsy patients from the University of Siena with seizure annotations by neurologists.

items.name: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset
items.description: 1,500+ 64-channel EEG recordings from 109 volunteers performing real and imagined motor tasks; widely used for brain–computer interface research.

paper.label: Schalk G et al. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2004;51:1034

items.name: NeuroDataSets (R package)
items.description: R package bundling a diverse collection of ready-to-use datasets on the brain, nervous system and neurological and psychiatric disorders, each documented with its original source and licence.
items.access_note: install.packages("NeuroDataSets") from CRAN; source on GitHub.

items.name: UPENN-GBM
items.description: Multiparametric MRI of 630 glioblastoma patients with tumour segmentations, radiomic features, genomics and survival.

paper.label: Bakas S et al. Sci Data 2022;9:453

items.name: BraTS-Africa
items.description: Pre-operative brain MRI with glioma segmentations for 146 patients from Nigeria, addressing under-representation of African populations.
items.provider: BraTS / Medical Artificial Intelligence Lab, Lagos

items.name: ATLAS v2.0
items.full_name: Anatomical Tracings of Lesions After Stroke
items.description: 955 T1-weighted MRIs of stroke patients with manually segmented lesions from 33 cohorts worldwide.
items.access_note: Free ICPSR login and data use agreement.

paper.label: Liew SL et al. Sci Data 2022;9:320

items.name: NYUMets: Brain
items.description: Longitudinal MRI, segmentations, treatment (gamma knife) and outcome data of patients with brain metastases from NYU Langone.
items.access_note: Free; request access and sign a data use agreement.

items.name: EEGEyeNet
items.description: Simultaneous high-density EEG and eye-tracking recordings from 356 participants (47+ hours) for gaze estimation benchmarks.

paper.label: Kastrati A et al. NeurIPS 2021 Datasets & Benchmarks
